Add `just agent-cost` (or a flag on rg-compare) that prints the table and a one-line summary; make output deterministic (no timing). Gate: report-only for now (no threshold) but print a failing marker if monokl's median bytes exceed the rg-policy median on any set or if monokl answerable-in-one-turn rate drops below 0.8; record the baseline numbers in docs/spec/05-research-and-decisions.md as a new entry (what is measured, the policy, today's numbers, what it does not prove — it is not a model eval). default:

    cargo llvm-cov nextest --workspace --all-features --locked --lcov --output-path lcov.info

    python3 -I scripts/bench.py {{ args }}

1	#!/usr/bin/env python3
2	"""Compares `monokl search` with ripgrep on pinned public repositories.
3	
4	monokl is meant to return the few right answers, not everything that matches. So ripgrep supplies the ground truth for
5	what is right, and the score rewards targeting:
6	
7	- definitions: files that declare the identifier. The gate is whether one of them is among monokl's first `--top` files
8	  (hit@top), because an agent that asks for a symbol must be shown where it is declared, early.
9	- declaration_in_output: whether the declaration's own line appears in monokl's output, so the agent needs no second
10	  read of the file. Reported, not gated.
11	- cost: files and output size monokl returns with its default caps, against one `rg -n` call. rg wins on a bare
12	  identifier, so this is the floor to beat; monokl's case is the question that takes rg several calls.
13	- test files are left out of the lists, as monokl leaves them out by default. `--tests` also runs monokl with its test
14	  flag and reports how many test files with the word it returned, ungated.
15	
16	Questions (scripts/rg-compare.questions) score the case monokl exists for: two to four words that take several rg calls,
17	with a known answer file and symbol. Each reports the answer file's rank, whether the declaration line is in the output,
18	the rg route's narrowing cost (files with any word, files with all words, bytes of one `rg -n` call for any word) and
19	monokl's output bytes. The gate is the answer file in monokl's first `--top` files for at least `--min-question-recall`
20	of the questions.
21	
22	Member questions use the same file format with the symbol cell written `member:name`: the answer is a method,
23	constructor, accessor or arrow-function property declared on an indented line inside a class. The script re-checks that
24	line with rg and scores them on their own line, apart from the top-level questions. A member question is a hit when the
25	answer file is in monokl's first `--top` files and the member's declaration line is in the output; the gate is
26	`--min-member-recall`.
27	
28	Each repository has a language (the optional fourth column of rg-compare.repos, default `ts`). A `rust` repository is
29	searched with `*.rs`, its declarations are `fn|struct|enum|trait|type|const|static|mod|macro_rules!` at the start of a
30	line (optional `pub`, `pub(crate)`), and its members are `fn` and `const` on an indented line inside an `impl` or
31	`trait` block. `tests/` directories are test files; `#[cfg(test)]` modules are test code for the analyzer, but this
32	script works on whole files and cannot split them, so a `mod tests` is skipped when sampling and test code inside
33	source files still counts as source here. monokl runs without `--language`, which searches every registered language,
34	so no flag is passed. Rust rows (identifiers, questions and members together) are scored apart from the TypeScript
35	gates and gated by `--min-rust-recall`, which defaults to 0.9 now that the analyzer ships. A Rust repository that monokl
36	cannot search yet scores 0 hits, which the report states.
37	
38	Held-out rows guard against tuning to the pinned set. A repository whose options include `held-out` in rg-compare.repos is
39	never sampled for identifiers, and its questions carry a fifth cell `held_out` in rg-compare.questions. They are scored
40	like the tuned questions and members but on their own `held-out questions` and `held-out members` lines, gated by

44	A repository whose options also include `report-only` is scored and printed per repository but never gates; the marker

68	class Lang:
69	    """What this script owns about a language: the declaration shapes and which monokl languages it covers. Which files
70	    belong to a language and which are tests is monokl's rule, read from the binary by `configure`."""
71	
72	    def __init__(self, languages, top_level, member_modifiers, skip_terms=()):
73	        self.languages = languages
74	        self.globs = []
75	        self.rules = []
76	        self.top_level = top_level
77	        self.declaration = top_level + r"([A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]{3,})"
78	        self.member_modifiers = member_modifiers
79	        self.skip_terms = skip_terms

82	LANGS = {
83	    "ts": Lang(
84	        languages=["typescript", "javascript"],
85	        # A top-level declaration starts its line. Indented ones are locals and loop variables, which monokl does not
86	        # index.
87	        top_level=r"^(?:export\s+)?(?:default\s+)?(?:declare\s+)?(?:abstract\s+)?(?:async\s+)?(?:function\*?|class|interface|type|enum|const|let|var)\s+",
88	        # An indented class member: optional modifiers, then the name followed by a call signature or an arrow value.
89	        member_modifiers=r"^\s+(?:(?:static|async|public|private|protected|readonly|override|get|set)\s+)*\*?",
90	    ),
91	    "rust": Lang(
92	        languages=["rust"],
93	        # Top-level items start their line; `pub`, `pub(crate)` and the fn qualifiers are optional.
94	        top_level=r"^(?:pub(?:\([a-z:]+\))?\s+)?(?:(?:const|async|unsafe|extern(?:\s+\"[A-Za-z]+\")?)\s+)*(?:fn|struct|enum|trait|type|const|static|mod|macro_rules!)\s+",
95	        # An indented `fn` or `const` inside an impl or trait block.
96	        member_modifiers=r"^\s+(?:pub(?:\([a-z:]+\))?\s+)?(?:(?:const|async|unsafe)\s+)*(?:fn|const)\s+",
97	        skip_terms=("tests",),
98	    ),

103	def configure(binary):
104	    """Reads which files each language owns, and which are tests, from `monokl language-rules`."""
105	    global TEST_DIRS
106	    rules = json.loads(run([binary, "language-rules"]).stdout)
107	    TEST_DIRS = tuple(rules["test_dirs"])
108	    by_name = {entry["name"]: entry for entry in rules["languages"]}
109	    for lang in LANGS.values():
110	        lang.rules = [by_name[name] for name in lang.languages]
111	        lang.globs = [f"*.{ext}" for rule in lang.rules for ext in rule["extensions"]]
112	        lang.globs += [f"!*{suffix}" for rule in lang.rules for suffix in rule["excluded_suffixes"]]

115	def is_test_path(relative, lang):
116	    """Whether monokl treats `relative` as a test file: under a test directory, or named like one of its language."""
117	    *directories, name = relative.split("/")
118	    if any(directory in TEST_DIRS for directory in directories):
119	        return True
120	    stem, _, extension = name.rpartition(".")
121	    for rule in lang.rules:
122	        if extension not in rule["extensions"] or any(name.endswith(s) for s in rule["excluded_suffixes"]):
123	            continue
124	        if stem in rule["test_stems"] or stem.endswith(tuple(rule["test_stem_suffixes"])):
125	            return True
126	    return False

153	def checkout(name, url, sha):
154	    path = CACHE / name
155	    if (path / ".git").exists() and run(["git", "rev-parse", "HEAD"], cwd=path).stdout.strip() == sha:
156	        return path
157	    path.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
158	    run(["git", "init", "-q"], cwd=path)
159	    run(["git", "fetch", "-q", "--depth", "1", url, sha], cwd=path)
160	    run(["git", "checkout", "-q", "FETCH_HEAD"], cwd=path)
161	    return path

164	def rg_files(pattern, path, lang, extra=()):
165	    args = ["rg", "--files-with-matches", *extra]
166	    for glob in lang.globs:
167	        args += ["--glob", glob]
168	    out = run([*args, "-e", pattern, "."], cwd=path, check=False).stdout
169	    return {line.removeprefix("./") for line in out.splitlines() if line}

172	def mentions(term, path, lang):
173	    return rg_files(re.escape(term), path, lang, ["--ignore-case", "--word-regexp"])

176	def declaration_pattern(term, lang, member=False):
177	    name = re.escape(term)
178	    if member and lang is LANGS["rust"]:
179	        return rf"{lang.member_modifiers}{name}\b"
180	    if member:
181	        call = rf"{lang.member_modifiers}{name}\s*(?:<[^>]*>)?\("
182	        arrow = rf"{lang.member_modifiers}{name}\s*(?::[^=]+)?=\s*(?:async\s*)?(?:\(|\w+\s*=>)"
183	        return f"{call}|{arrow}"
184	    return rf"{lang.top_level}{name}\b"

187	def definitions(term, path, lang, member=False):
188	    return rg_files(declaration_pattern(term, lang, member), path, lang)

191	def monokl_files(binary, term, path, tests):
192	    """Runs monokl with its default caps, as an agent would, and returns the files in rank order and the output size."""
193	    args = [binary, "search", term, "."]
194	    if tests:
195	        args.append("--tests")
196	    out = run(args, cwd=path, check=False).stdout
197	    files = []
198	    for line in out.splitlines():
199	        if line.startswith("  ") and "," in line:
200	            file = line.strip().split(",", 1)[0].removeprefix("./")
201	            if file not in files:
202	                files.append(file)
203	    return files, out

206	def declaration_line(term, files, path, lang, member=False):
207	    """The text of the first top-level (or, for a member, indented) declaration of `term` in `files`, as ripgrep finds it."""
208	    for file in sorted(files):
209	        out = run(["rg", "--no-filename", "--max-count", "1", "-e", declaration_pattern(term, lang, member), file], cwd=path,
210	                  check=False).stdout
211	        if out.strip():
212	            return out.strip()
213	    return None

216	def rg_output_bytes(term, path, lang):
217	    """Size of the lines an agent reads from one `rg -n` call, the cheapest rg route to the same files."""
218	    args = ["rg", "-n", "--word-regexp", "--ignore-case"]
219	    for glob in lang.globs:
220	        args += ["--glob", glob]
221	    return len(run([*args, "-e", re.escape(term), "."], cwd=path, check=False).stdout.encode())

224	def sample_terms(path, count, lang):
225	    args = ["rg", "--no-filename", "--only-matching", "--no-line-number", "--replace", "$1"]
226	    for glob in lang.globs:
227	        args += ["--glob", glob]
228	    out = run([*args, "-e", lang.declaration, "."], cwd=path, check=False).stdout
229	    names = sorted(set(out.split()) - set(lang.skip_terms))
230	    if len(names) <= count:
231	        return names
232	    step = len(names) / count
233	    return [names[int(i * step)] for i in range(count)]

236	def timed(fn, *args):
237	    start = time.perf_counter()
238	    result = fn(*args)
239	    return result, (time.perf_counter() - start) * 1000

242	def split(files, lang):
243	    tests = {f for f in files if is_test_path(f, lang)}
244	    return set(files) - tests, tests

247	def first_rank(ordered, wanted):
248	    """1-based position of the first file in `ordered` that is in `wanted`, or None."""
249	    return next((i for i, f in enumerate(ordered, 1) if f in wanted), None)

252	def question_rows(only):
253	    for line in QUESTIONS.read_text().splitlines():
254	        if line.strip() and not line.startswith("#"):
255	            repo, words, file, symbol, *flags = (cell.strip() for cell in line.split("|"))
256	            member = symbol.startswith("member:")
257	            if not only or repo in only:
258	                yield repo, words, file, symbol.removeprefix("member:"), member, "held_out" in flags

261	def score_questions(binary, only):
262	    """Runs every question and returns one row each. Fails if the answer's declaration is not in the pinned checkout."""
263	    report_only = report_only_repositories()
264	    checkouts = {name: (checkout(name, url, sha), lang, held) for name, url, sha, lang, held in repositories(only)}
265	    rows = []
266	    for repo, words, file, symbol, member, held_out in question_rows(only):
267	        path, lang, held_repo = checkouts[repo]
268	        if held_out != held_repo:
269	            sys.exit(f"{repo}: held_out flags and the held-out repository marker must agree; fix rg-compare.questions")
270	        if file not in definitions(symbol, path, lang, member):
271	            kind = "a class member" if member else "declared"
272	            sys.exit(f"{repo}: `{symbol}` is not {kind} in {file} at the pinned sha; fix rg-compare.questions")
273	        terms = words.split()
274	        per_word = [split(mentions(t, path, lang), lang)[0] for t in terms]
275	        rg_args = ["rg", "-n", "--ignore-case", "--word-regexp"]
276	        for glob in lang.globs:
277	            rg_args += ["--glob", glob]
278	        for term in terms:
279	            rg_args += ["-e", re.escape(term)]
280	        rg_out = run([*rg_args, "."], cwd=path, check=False).stdout
281	        rg_lines = [l for l in rg_out.splitlines() if not is_test_path(l.removeprefix("./").split(":", 1)[0], lang)]
282	        ordered, output = monokl_files(binary, words, path, False)
283	        non_test = [f for f in ordered if not is_test_path(f, lang)]
284	        declaration = declaration_line(symbol, {file}, path, lang, member)
285	        bare = str.maketrans("", "", '"\\')
286	        bare_declaration = re.sub(r"^(?:export\s+|default\s+|declare\s+)+", "", declaration).rstrip(" {;")
287	        rows.append(
288	            {
289	                "repo": repo,
290	                "language": "rust" if lang is LANGS["rust"] else "ts",
291	                "words": words,
292	                "file": file,
293	                "symbol": symbol,
294	                "member": member,
295	                "held_out": held_out,
296	                "report_only": repo in report_only,
297	                "rank": non_test.index(file) + 1 if file in non_test else None,
298	                "declaration_in_output": bare_declaration[:40].translate(bare) in output.translate(bare),
299	                "rg_any_files": len(set.union(*per_word)),
300	                "rg_all_files": len(set.intersection(*per_word)),
301	                "rg_n_bytes": len("\n".join(rg_lines).encode()),
302	                "monokl_bytes": len(output.encode()),
303	            }
304	        )
305	    return rows

308	def main():
309	    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__, formatter_class=argparse.RawDescriptionHelpFormatter)
310	    parser.add_argument("--binary", default=str(ROOT / "target" / "release" / "monokl"))
311	    parser.add_argument("--repo", action="append", help="limit to a repository name from rg-compare.repos")
312	    parser.add_argument("--terms", type=int, default=25, help="identifiers sampled per repository")
313	    parser.add_argument("--top", type=int, default=3, help="a declaration must appear within this many files")
314	    parser.add_argument("--min-recall", type=float, default=0.95, help="fail when the share of hits is lower")
315	    parser.add_argument("--min-question-recall", type=float, default=0.9,
316	                        help="fail when the share of questions with the answer file in the top files is lower")
317	    parser.add_argument("--min-member-recall", type=float, default=0.9,
318	                        help="fail when the share of member questions with the answer file in the top files and the "
319	                             "member's declaration in the output is lower")
320	    parser.add_argument("--min-rust-recall", type=float, default=0.9,
321	                        help="fail when the share of Rust hits (identifiers, questions and members pooled) is lower; "
322	                             "0.9 by default")
323	    parser.add_argument("--min-heldout-recall", type=float, default=0.9,
324	                        help="fail when the share of held-out questions with the answer file in the top files is lower; "
325	                             "0.9 by default")
326	    parser.add_argument("--min-heldout-member-recall", type=float, default=0.9,
327	                        help="fail when the share of held-out member questions is lower; 0.9 by default")
328	    parser.add_argument("--min-heldout-rust-recall", type=float, default=0.9,
329	                        help="fail when the share of gated held-out Rust rows is lower; 0.9 by default")
330	    parser.add_argument("--no-questions", action="store_true", help="skip the question set")
331	    parser.add_argument("--tests", action="store_true", help="also score test files, ungated")

335	    if not Path(args.binary).exists():
336	        sys.exit(f"{args.binary} not found; run `cargo build --release` or pass --binary")
337	    configure(args.binary)
338	
339	    report = []
340	    for name, url, sha, lang, held_out in repositories(args.repo):
341	        if held_out:
342	            continue  # held-out repositories only score their questions
343	        path = checkout(name, url, sha)
344	        rows = []
345	        for term in sample_terms(path, args.terms, lang):
346	            defs, def_tests = split(definitions(term, path, lang), lang)
347	            seen, seen_tests = split(mentions(term, path, lang), lang)
348	            (ordered, output), monokl_ms = timed(monokl_files, args.binary, term, path, args.tests)
349	            monokl_bytes = len(output.encode())
350	            declaration = declaration_line(term, defs, path, lang)
351	            # The first 40 characters of the declaration's line, because a signature or snippet may cut a long one.
352	            # TOON quotes and escapes cells, so compare with quotes and backslashes removed on both sides.
353	            bare = str.maketrans("", "", '"\\')
354	            # A signature drops the opening brace, so compare without trailing braces and semicolons.
355	            # and its export, default and declare keywords.
356	            wanted = None
357	            if declaration:
358	                bare_declaration = re.sub(r"^(?:export\s+|default\s+|declare\s+)+", "", declaration).rstrip(" {;")
359	                wanted = bare_declaration[:40].translate(bare)
360	            answered = wanted is not None and wanted in output.translate(bare)
361	            non_test = [f for f in ordered if not is_test_path(f, lang)]
362	            found, found_tests = split(ordered, lang)
363	            _, rg_ms = timed(mentions, term, path, lang)
364	            rank = first_rank(non_test, defs)
365	            rows.append(
366	                {
367	                    "term": term,
368	                    "defs": len(defs),
369	                    "def_rank": rank,
370	                    "answered": answered,
371	                    "returned": len(non_test),

427	    report_only_questions = [q for q in held_questions if q["report_only"]]

434	    question_hits = 0
435	    for q in questions:
436	        in_top = q["rank"] is not None and q["rank"] <= args.top
437	        question_hits += in_top
438	        print(
439	            f"  {'ok  ' if in_top else 'MISS'} {q['repo']}: {q['words']!r} -> {q['symbol']} "

448	        print(f"question answer file in top {args.top}: {question_hits}/{len(questions)} = {question_rate:.2%} "
449	              f"(gate {args.min_question_recall:.2%})")
450	    else:

453	    for q in members:

455	        member_hits += hit
456	        print(
457	            f"  {'ok  ' if hit else 'MISS'} {q['repo']}: {q['words']!r} -> member {q['symbol']} "

471	    rust_hits_total = rust_hits

482	    rust_pass = True
483	    if rust_total:

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Compares `monokl search` with ripgrep on pinned public repositories.

monokl is meant to return the few right answers, not everything that matches. So ripgrep supplies the ground truth for
what is right, and the score rewards targeting:

- definitions: files that declare the identifier. The gate is whether one of them is among monokl's first `--top` files
  (hit@top), because an agent that asks for a symbol must be shown where it is declared, early.
- declaration_in_output: whether the declaration's own line appears in monokl's output, so the agent needs no second
  read of the file. Reported, not gated.
- cost: files and output size monokl returns with its default caps, against one `rg -n` call. rg wins on a bare
  identifier, so this is the floor to beat; monokl's case is the question that takes rg several calls.
- test files are left out of the lists, as monokl leaves them out by default. `--tests` also runs monokl with its test
  flag and reports how many test files with the word it returned, ungated.

Questions (scripts/rg-compare.questions) score the case monokl exists for: two to four words that take several rg calls,
with a known answer file and symbol. Each reports the answer file's rank, whether the declaration line is in the output,
the rg route's narrowing cost (files with any word, files with all words, bytes of one `rg -n` call for any word) and
monokl's output bytes. The gate is the answer file in monokl's first `--top` files for at least `--min-question-recall`
of the questions.

Member questions use the same file format with the symbol cell written `member:name`: the answer is a method,
constructor, accessor or arrow-function property declared on an indented line inside a class. The script re-checks that
line with rg and scores them on their own line, apart from the top-level questions. A member question is a hit when the
answer file is in monokl's first `--top` files and the member's declaration line is in the output; the gate is
`--min-member-recall`.

Each repository has a language (the optional fourth column of rg-compare.repos, default `ts`). A `rust` repository is
searched with `*.rs`, its declarations are `fn|struct|enum|trait|type|const|static|mod|macro_rules!` at the start of a
line (optional `pub`, `pub(crate)`), and its members are `fn` and `const` on an indented line inside an `impl` or
`trait` block. `tests/` directories are test files; `#[cfg(test)]` modules are test code for the analyzer, but this
script works on whole files and cannot split them, so a `mod tests` is skipped when sampling and test code inside
source files still counts as source here. monokl runs without `--language`, which searches every registered language,
so no flag is passed. Rust rows (identifiers, questions and members together) are scored apart from the TypeScript
gates and gated by `--min-rust-recall`, which defaults to 0.9 now that the analyzer ships. A Rust repository that monokl
cannot search yet scores 0 hits, which the report states.

Held-out rows guard against tuning to the pinned set. A repository whose options include `held-out` in rg-compare.repos is
never sampled for identifiers, and its questions carry a fifth cell `held_out` in rg-compare.questions. They are scored
like the tuned questions and members but on their own `held-out questions` and `held-out members` lines, gated by
`--min-heldout-recall` and `--min-heldout-member-recall`, both 0.9, set from the first measured scores (23/24 and 12/12). Ranking changes may be tuned
on the other rows and must be reported on these.

A repository whose options also include `report-only` is scored and printed per repository but never gates; the marker
comes off once the repository passes 0.9. Gated held-out Rust rows are pooled on a `held-out rust` line, gated by
`--min-heldout-rust-recall`.

Wall time is reported. Repositories are cloned on demand into target/rg-compare.
"""

import argparse
import json
import re
import statistics
import subprocess
import sys
import time
from pathlib import Path

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent
MANIFEST = ROOT / "scripts" / "rg-compare.repos"
QUESTIONS = ROOT / "scripts" / "rg-compare.questions"
CACHE = ROOT / "target" / "rg-compare"
UNCAPPED ="1000000"
HELD_OUT = "held-out"
REPORT_ONLY = "report-only"

class Lang:
    """What this script owns about a language: the declaration shapes and which monokl languages it covers. Which files
    belong to a language and which are tests is monokl's rule, read from the binary by `configure`."""

    def __init__(self, languages, top_level, member_modifiers, skip_terms=()):
        self.languages = languages
        self.globs = []
        self.rules = []
        self.top_level = top_level
        self.declaration = top_level + r"([A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]{3,})"
        self.member_modifiers = member_modifiers
        self.skip_terms = skip_terms


LANGS = {
    "ts": Lang(
        languages=["typescript", "javascript"],
        # A top-level declaration starts its line. Indented ones are locals and loop variables, which monokl does not
        # index.
        top_level=r"^(?:export\s+)?(?:default\s+)?(?:declare\s+)?(?:abstract\s+)?(?:async\s+)?(?:function\*?|class|interface|type|enum|const|let|var)\s+",
        # An indented class member: optional modifiers, then the name followed by a call signature or an arrow value.
        member_modifiers=r"^\s+(?:(?:static|async|public|private|protected|readonly|override|get|set)\s+)*\*?",
    ),
    "rust": Lang(
        languages=["rust"],
        # Top-level items start their line; `pub`, `pub(crate)` and the fn qualifiers are optional.
        top_level=r"^(?:pub(?:\([a-z:]+\))?\s+)?(?:(?:const|async|unsafe|extern(?:\s+\"[A-Za-z]+\")?)\s+)*(?:fn|struct|enum|trait|type|const|static|mod|macro_rules!)\s+",
        # An indented `fn` or `const` inside an impl or trait block.
        member_modifiers=r"^\s+(?:pub(?:\([a-z:]+\))?\s+)?(?:(?:const|async|unsafe)\s+)*(?:fn|const)\s+",
        skip_terms=("tests",),
    ),
}
TEST_DIRS = ()


def configure(binary):
    """Reads which files each language owns, and which are tests, from `monokl language-rules`."""
    global TEST_DIRS
    rules = json.loads(run([binary, "language-rules"]).stdout)
    TEST_DIRS = tuple(rules["test_dirs"])
    by_name = {entry["name"]: entry for entry in rules["languages"]}
    for lang in LANGS.values():
        lang.rules = [by_name[name] for name in lang.languages]
        lang.globs = [f"*.{ext}" for rule in lang.rules for ext in rule["extensions"]]
        lang.globs += [f"!*{suffix}" for rule in lang.rules for suffix in rule["excluded_suffixes"]]


def is_test_path(relative, lang):
    """Whether monokl treats `relative` as a test file: under a test directory, or named like one of its language."""
    *directories, name = relative.split("/")
    if any(directory in TEST_DIRS for directory in directories):
        return True
    stem, _, extension = name.rpartition(".")
    for rule in lang.rules:
        if extension not in rule["extensions"] or any(name.endswith(s) for s in rule["excluded_suffixes"]):
            continue
        if stem in rule["test_stems"] or stem.endswith(tuple(rule["test_stem_suffixes"])):
            return True
    return False


def run(args, cwd=None, check=True):
    return subprocess.run(args, cwd=cwd, capture_output=True, text=True, check=check)


def repositories(only):
    for line in MANIFEST.read_text().splitlines():
        if line.strip() and not line.startswith("#"):
            name, url, sha, *options = line.split()
            if not only or name in only:
                language = options[0] if options and options[0] not in (HELD_OUT, REPORT_ONLY) else "ts"
                yield name, url, sha, LANGS[language], HELD_OUT in options


def report_only_repositories():
    """Names of repositories whose options include `report-only`: scored and printed, never gated."""
    names = set()
    for line in MANIFEST.read_text().splitlines():
        if line.strip() and not line.startswith("#"):
            name, _url, _sha, *options = line.split()
            if REPORT_ONLY in options:
                names.add(name)
    return names


def checkout(name, url, sha):
    path = CACHE / name
    if (path / ".git").exists() and run(["git", "rev-parse", "HEAD"], cwd=path).stdout.strip() == sha:
        return path
    path.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    run(["git", "init", "-q"], cwd=path)
    run(["git", "fetch", "-q", "--depth", "1", url, sha], cwd=path)
    run(["git", "checkout", "-q", "FETCH_HEAD"], cwd=path)
    return path


def rg_files(pattern, path, lang, extra=()):
    args = ["rg", "--files-with-matches", *extra]
    for glob in lang.globs:
        args += ["--glob", glob]
    out = run([*args, "-e", pattern, "."], cwd=path, check=False).stdout
    return {line.removeprefix("./") for line in out.splitlines() if line}


def mentions(term, path, lang):
    return rg_files(re.escape(term), path, lang, ["--ignore-case", "--word-regexp"])


def declaration_pattern(term, lang, member=False):
    name = re.escape(term)
    if member and lang is LANGS["rust"]:
        return rf"{lang.member_modifiers}{name}\b"
    if member:
        call = rf"{lang.member_modifiers}{name}\s*(?:<[^>]*>)?\("
        arrow = rf"{lang.member_modifiers}{name}\s*(?::[^=]+)?=\s*(?:async\s*)?(?:\(|\w+\s*=>)"
        return f"{call}|{arrow}"
    return rf"{lang.top_level}{name}\b"


def definitions(term, path, lang, member=False):
    return rg_files(declaration_pattern(term, lang, member), path, lang)


def monokl_files(binary, term, path, tests):
    """Runs monokl with its default caps, as an agent would, and returns the files in rank order and the output size."""
    args = [binary, "search", term, "."]
    if tests:
        args.append("--tests")
    out = run(args, cwd=path, check=False).stdout
    files = []
    for line in out.splitlines():
        if line.startswith("  ") and "," in line:
            file = line.strip().split(",", 1)[0].removeprefix("./")
            if file not in files:
                files.append(file)
    return files, out


def declaration_line(term, files, path, lang, member=False):
    """The text of the first top-level (or, for a member, indented) declaration of `term` in `files`, as ripgrep finds it."""
    for file in sorted(files):
        out = run(["rg", "--no-filename", "--max-count", "1", "-e", declaration_pattern(term, lang, member), file], cwd=path,
                  check=False).stdout
        if out.strip():
            return out.strip()
    return None


def rg_output_bytes(term, path, lang):
    """Size of the lines an agent reads from one `rg -n` call, the cheapest rg route to the same files."""
    args = ["rg", "-n", "--word-regexp", "--ignore-case"]
    for glob in lang.globs:
        args += ["--glob", glob]
    return len(run([*args, "-e", re.escape(term), "."], cwd=path, check=False).stdout.encode())


def sample_terms(path, count, lang):
    args = ["rg", "--no-filename", "--only-matching", "--no-line-number", "--replace", "$1"]
    for glob in lang.globs:
        args += ["--glob", glob]
    out = run([*args, "-e", lang.declaration, "."], cwd=path, check=False).stdout
    names = sorted(set(out.split()) - set(lang.skip_terms))
    if len(names) <= count:
        return names
    step = len(names) / count
    return [names[int(i * step)] for i in range(count)]


def timed(fn, *args):
    start = time.perf_counter()
    result = fn(*args)
    return result, (time.perf_counter() - start) * 1000


def split(files, lang):
    tests = {f for f in files if is_test_path(f, lang)}
    return set(files) - tests, tests


def first_rank(ordered, wanted):
    """1-based position of the first file in `ordered` that is in `wanted`, or None."""
    return next((i for i, f in enumerate(ordered, 1) if f in wanted), None)


def question_rows(only):
    for line in QUESTIONS.read_text().splitlines():
        if line.strip() and not line.startswith("#"):
            repo, words, file, symbol, *flags = (cell.strip() for cell in line.split("|"))
            member = symbol.startswith("member:")
            if not only or repo in only:
                yield repo, words, file, symbol.removeprefix("member:"), member, "held_out" in flags


def score_questions(binary, only):
    """Runs every question and returns one row each. Fails if the answer's declaration is not in the pinned checkout."""
    report_only = report_only_repositories()
    checkouts = {name: (checkout(name, url, sha), lang, held) for name, url, sha, lang, held in repositories(only)}
    rows = []
    for repo, words, file, symbol, member, held_out in question_rows(only):
        path, lang, held_repo = checkouts[repo]
        if held_out != held_repo:
            sys.exit(f"{repo}: held_out flags and the held-out repository marker must agree; fix rg-compare.questions")
        if file not in definitions(symbol, path, lang, member):
            kind = "a class member" if member else "declared"
            sys.exit(f"{repo}: `{symbol}` is not {kind} in {file} at the pinned sha; fix rg-compare.questions")
        terms = words.split()
        per_word = [split(mentions(t, path, lang), lang)[0] for t in terms]
        rg_args = ["rg", "-n", "--ignore-case", "--word-regexp"]
        for glob in lang.globs:
            rg_args += ["--glob", glob]
        for term in terms:
            rg_args += ["-e", re.escape(term)]
        rg_out = run([*rg_args, "."], cwd=path, check=False).stdout
        rg_lines = [l for l in rg_out.splitlines() if not is_test_path(l.removeprefix("./").split(":", 1)[0], lang)]
        ordered, output = monokl_files(binary, words, path, False)
        non_test = [f for f in ordered if not is_test_path(f, lang)]
        declaration = declaration_line(symbol, {file}, path, lang, member)
        bare = str.maketrans("", "", '"\\')
        bare_declaration = re.sub(r"^(?:export\s+|default\s+|declare\s+)+", "", declaration).rstrip(" {;")
        rows.append(
            {
                "repo": repo,
                "language": "rust" if lang is LANGS["rust"] else "ts",
                "words": words,
                "file": file,
                "symbol": symbol,
                "member": member,
                "held_out": held_out,
                "report_only": repo in report_only,
                "rank": non_test.index(file) + 1 if file in non_test else None,
                "declaration_in_output": bare_declaration[:40].translate(bare) in output.translate(bare),
                "rg_any_files": len(set.union(*per_word)),
                "rg_all_files": len(set.intersection(*per_word)),
                "rg_n_bytes": len("\n".join(rg_lines).encode()),
                "monokl_bytes": len(output.encode()),
            }
        )
    return rows


def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__, formatter_class=argparse.RawDescriptionHelpFormatter)
    parser.add_argument("--binary", default=str(ROOT / "target" / "release" / "monokl"))
    parser.add_argument("--repo", action="append", help="limit to a repository name from rg-compare.repos")
    parser.add_argument("--terms", type=int, default=25, help="identifiers sampled per repository")
    parser.add_argument("--top", type=int, default=3, help="a declaration must appear within this many files")
    parser.add_argument("--min-recall", type=float, default=0.95, help="fail when the share of hits is lower")
    parser.add_argument("--min-question-recall", type=float, default=0.9,
                        help="fail when the share of questions with the answer file in the top files is lower")
    parser.add_argument("--min-member-recall", type=float, default=0.9,
                        help="fail when the share of member questions with the answer file in the top files and the "
                             "member's declaration in the output is lower")
    parser.add_argument("--min-rust-recall", type=float, default=0.9,
                        help="fail when the share of Rust hits (identifiers, questions and members pooled) is lower; "
                             "0.9 by default")
    parser.add_argument("--min-heldout-recall", type=float, default=0.9,
                        help="fail when the share of held-out questions with the answer file in the top files is lower; "
                             "0.9 by default")
    parser.add_argument("--min-heldout-member-recall", type=float, default=0.9,
                        help="fail when the share of held-out member questions is lower; 0.9 by default")
    parser.add_argument("--min-heldout-rust-recall", type=float, default=0.9,
                        help="fail when the share of gated held-out Rust rows is lower; 0.9 by default")
    parser.add_argument("--no-questions", action="store_true", help="skip the question set")
    parser.add_argument("--tests", action="store_true", help="also score test files, ungated")
    parser.add_argument("--json", help="write the full result to this path")
    args = parser.parse_args()

    if not Path(args.binary).exists():
        sys.exit(f"{args.binary} not found; run `cargo build --release` or pass --binary")
    configure(args.binary)

    report = []
    for name, url, sha, lang, held_out in repositories(args.repo):
        if held_out:
            continue  # held-out repositories only score their questions
        path = checkout(name, url, sha)
        rows = []
        for term in sample_terms(path, args.terms, lang):
            defs, def_tests = split(definitions(term, path, lang), lang)
            seen, seen_tests = split(mentions(term, path, lang), lang)
            (ordered, output), monokl_ms = timed(monokl_files, args.binary, term, path, args.tests)
            monokl_bytes = len(output.encode())
            declaration = declaration_line(term, defs, path, lang)
            # The first 40 characters of the declaration's line, because a signature or snippet may cut a long one.
            # TOON quotes and escapes cells, so compare with quotes and backslashes removed on both sides.
            bare = str.maketrans("", "", '"\\')
            # A signature drops the opening brace, so compare without trailing braces and semicolons.
            # and its export, default and declare keywords.
            wanted = None
            if declaration:
                bare_declaration = re.sub(r"^(?:export\s+|default\s+|declare\s+)+", "", declaration).rstrip(" {;")
                wanted = bare_declaration[:40].translate(bare)
            answered = wanted is not None and wanted in output.translate(bare)
            non_test = [f for f in ordered if not is_test_path(f, lang)]
            found, found_tests = split(ordered, lang)
            _, rg_ms = timed(mentions, term, path, lang)
            rank = first_rank(non_test, defs)
            rows.append(
                {
                    "term": term,
                    "defs": len(defs),
                    "def_rank": rank,
                    "answered": answered,
                    "returned": len(non_test),
                    "rg_files": len(seen | defs),
                    "monokl_bytes": monokl_bytes,
                    "rg_bytes": rg_output_bytes(term, path, lang),
                    "tests": len(seen_tests | def_tests),
                    "tests_hit": len((seen_tests | def_tests) & found_tests),
                    "rg_ms": rg_ms,
                    "monokl_ms": monokl_ms,
                    "top": non_test[:3],
                }
            )
        report.append({"repo": name, "sha": sha, "language": "rust" if lang is LANGS["rust"] else "ts", "rows": rows})

    scored = hits = 0
    rust_scored = rust_hits = 0
    for repo in report:
        rows = [r for r in repo["rows"] if r["defs"]]
        repo_hits = sum(1 for r in rows if r["def_rank"] is not None and r["def_rank"] <= args.top)
        if repo["language"] == "rust":
            rust_scored += len(rows)
            rust_hits += repo_hits
        else:
            scored += len(rows)
            hits += repo_hits
        ranks = [r["def_rank"] for r in rows if r["def_rank"] is not None]
        returned = sum(r["returned"] for r in repo["rows"])
        rg_files = sum(r["rg_files"] for r in repo["rows"])
        line = (
            f"{repo['repo']:<10} defined_terms={len(rows):<3} hit@{args.top}={repo_hits}/{len(rows)} "
            f"median_rank={statistics.median(ranks) if ranks else '-'} "
            f"declaration_in_output={sum(1 for r in rows if r['answered'])}/{len(rows)} "
            f"files={returned} vs rg={rg_files} "
            f"output_kb monokl={sum(r['monokl_bytes'] for r in repo['rows']) / 1024:.0f} "
            f"rg_n={sum(r['rg_bytes'] for r in repo['rows']) / 1024:.0f} "
            f"median_ms rg={statistics.median(r['rg_ms'] for r in repo['rows']):.0f} "
            f"monokl={statistics.median(r['monokl_ms'] for r in repo['rows']):.0f}"
        )
        if args.tests:
            line += f" tests={sum(r['tests_hit'] for r in repo['rows'])}/{sum(r['tests'] for r in repo['rows'])}"
        print(line)
        for row in rows:
            if row["def_rank"] is None or row["def_rank"] > args.top:
                rank = row["def_rank"] or "absent"
                print(f"    declaration at rank {rank}: {row['term']} (top: {', '.join(row['top']) or 'nothing'})")

    # A gate with nothing to score is skipped and says so, instead of failing on a rate of 0/0.
    identifiers_pass = True
    if scored:
        rate = hits / scored
        identifiers_pass = rate >= args.min_recall
        print(f"declaration in top {args.top}: {hits}/{scored} = {rate:.2%} (gate {args.min_recall:.2%})")
    else:
        print("declaration in top: no declarations to score, gate skipped")

    scored_questions = [] if args.no_questions else score_questions(args.binary, args.repo)
    held_questions = [q for q in scored_questions if q["held_out"]]
    report_only_questions = [q for q in held_questions if q["report_only"]]
    held_questions = [q for q in held_questions if not q["report_only"]]

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Times `monokl search` against `rg` on pinned repositories and on a synthetic stress set. Not a correctness check.

Per (repo, query class, tool): `--runs` timed runs after `--warmups` untimed ones, reported as p50 and p95 wall ms, the
peak resident set size over the runs (from `/usr/bin/time`, macOS `-l` or Linux `-v`) and the bytes of output.
Everything is warm: the warm-ups and repeated runs leave the files in the OS page cache, and cold-cache runs are not
measured. A run that exits with a status above 1 or dies is a crash and a run over 60 s is a TIMEOUT; either makes the
script exit non-zero. There are no thresholds.

Query classes: identifier (a declared name), words (three declared names), broad (a very common word), regex
(`regex:\\bPREFIX\\w+`), nomatch (a word that occurs nowhere) and path (the broad word restricted to the directory
that declares the identifier). Identifiers are sampled from top-level declarations as rg-compare.py does, so the choice
is deterministic for a pinned checkout.

The stress set is generated into target/bench/stress: a 5 MB single-line JavaScript file, a 50,000-line generated
TypeScript file and 20,000 small files that each contain `needle`. `needle` is searched in each, with rg for comparison.

Repositories are cloned shallow into target/bench on demand.
"""

import argparse
import json
import os
import re
import signal
import statistics
import importlib.util
import subprocess
import sys
import time
from pathlib import Path

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent
MANIFEST = ROOT / "scripts" / "bench.repos"
CACHE = ROOT / "target" / "bench"
# rg-compare.py reads monokl's file and test rules from the binary; its file name has a hyphen, so load it by path.
_spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location("rg_compare", ROOT / "scripts" / "rg-compare.py")
RG_COMPARE = importlib.util.module_from_spec(_spec)
_spec.loader.exec_module(RG_COMPARE)
TIMEOUT_S = 60
NO_MATCH = "zqxjvkwpnomatchzz"
DARWIN = sys.platform == "darwin"
TIME = ["/usr/bin/time", "-l" if DARWIN else "-v"]

# language -> (top-level declaration regex, broad word). The regex is copied from rg-compare.py; the globs come from
# monokl itself through rg-compare.py's `configure`.
LANGS = {
    "ts": (
        r"^(?:export\s+)?(?:default\s+)?(?:declare\s+)?(?:abstract\s+)?(?:async\s+)?(?:function\*?|class|interface|type|enum|const|let|var)\s+",
        "string",

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""What a coding agent pays to answer each rg-compare question with `monokl search` against ripgrep alone. No model, no
timing: bytes, estimated tokens and turns, all deterministic for a pinned checkout and a binary.

Rows are the rg-compare harness's: sampled identifiers (rg-compare.repos), concept questions and member lookups
(rg-compare.questions), on every repository including the held-out and report-only ones. Sets mirror the harness's
lines: identifiers, questions, members, rust (fd identifiers, questions and members pooled), held-out questions,
held-out members, held-out rust and report-only (the repositories marked `report-only`), plus all.

monokl cost. One `monokl search <words> .` with default caps, as `rg-compare.py` runs it. Bytes are the size of its
stdout, tokens are ceil(bytes / 3) (the product's own estimate), turns are 1. The row is answerable in one turn when
one of the first 3 rows (blocks) is in the expected file, spans the expected declaration's line and shows the
declaration's text, so the agent needs no follow-up read. `monokl+read` is the same cost with one more turn for a
file read of the expected block when the row is not answerable, so a miss is not counted as free.

rg-policy cost. A fixed policy standing in for an agent that only has ripgrep. Every step favors rg:

  1. Best term. For an identifier, the identifier. For a question, the word whose `rg -n` output has the fewest
     non-test lines (at least one; ties go to the longer word, then alphabetical order), which an agent could only
     know by trying every word.
  2. Turn 1: `rg -n -S -w <best term>` over the language's source files. Test files are dropped, as monokl drops
     them. The agent reads the first 200 lines, each cut to 300 bytes, with no `./` prefix; matches are sorted by path.
  3. Turn 2, only when turn 1 matched more than 50 lines: a narrower `rg -n`, read the same way. For an identifier,
     the declaration pattern of that identifier. For a question, lines holding the two best words in either order.
     A question with fewer than two words that match has no narrower pattern and skips turn 2.
  4. Last turn: a file read of the smallest block of the expected file that holds the declaration, found by balancing
     brackets from the declaration line to the next line at the same or lower indentation. The block has no doc
     comment, decorators or attributes above it, and where an expected file declares the symbol more than once the
     smallest block counts. rg is never charged for failing to find the file: the policy always succeeds, and
     `rg_located` reports how often the expected file was in the lines the agent actually read.

Turns are the rg calls plus the read; bytes are the sum of the lines read in each call plus the read. `rg-early`
repeats the policy but stops, with no read, as soon as a turn shows the expected declaration's line; it is the cheaper
agent that trusts a matching line, and tokens use the same ceil(bytes / 3) as monokl.

Report only. A line starting `FAIL` is printed when a set's median monokl bytes exceed its median rg-policy bytes or
when its answerable-in-one-turn rate is below 0.8; the exit status stays 0. This is not a model evaluation: it says
what each route costs if the agent does what the policy says, not whether a model would find the answer.

Repositories are the clones `rg-compare.py` keeps in target/rg-compare, fetched on demand at the pinned shas.
"""

import argparse
import importlib.util
import json
import math
import re
import sys
from pathlib import Path

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent
# rg-compare.py owns the repositories, questions, declaration patterns and monokl's file rules; load it by path.
_spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location("rg_compare", ROOT / "scripts" / "rg-compare.py")
RC = importlib.util.module_from_spec(_spec)
_spec.loader.exec_module(RC)

TOP_ROWS = 3
FIRST_LINES = 200
LINE_CAP = 300
NARROW_ABOVE = 50
MIN_ONE_TURN = 0.8
ROW = re.compile(r"^  ([^,\n]+),(\d+),(\d+),")
BARE = str.maketrans("", "", '"\\')
CONTINUATION = ("|", "&", ".", "?", ":", "+", "-", "*", "/", "=", ",", "where", "extends", "implements", "{")
TOOLS = ("monokl", "monokl+read", "rg-policy", "rg-early")
SETS = ("identifiers", "questions", "members", "rust", "held-out questions", "held-out members", "held-out rust",
        "report-only", "all")


def tokens(byte_count):
    return math.ceil(byte_count / 3)


def percentile(values, share):
    """Nearest rank: the smallest value with at least `share` of the values at or below it."""
    ordered = sorted(values)
    return ordered[max(math.ceil(share * len(ordered)) - 1, 0)]


def median(values):
    ordered = sorted(values)
    mid = len(ordered) // 2
    return ordered[mid] if len(ordered) % 2 else (ordered[mid - 1] + ordered[mid]) / 2


def rg_lines(path, lang, pattern, extra=()):
    """Non-test `file:line:text` lines of one `rg -n` call, sorted by path so the first lines are stable."""
    args = ["rg", "-n", "--no-heading", "--color", "never", "--sort", "path", *extra]
    for glob in lang.globs:
        args += ["--glob", glob]
    out = RC.run([*args, "-e", pattern, "."], cwd=path, check=False).stdout
    lines = [line.removeprefix("./") for line in out.splitlines()]
    return [line for line in lines if not RC.is_test_path(line.split(":", 1)[0], lang)]


def read_cost(lines):
    """Bytes of the first lines an agent reads from one call, each cut at the cap, with its newline."""
    shown = [line[:LINE_CAP] for line in lines[:FIRST_LINES]]
    return shown, sum(len(line.encode()) + 1 for line in shown)


def word_lines(path, lang, word, cache):
    key = (str(path), word)
    if key not in cache:
        cache[key] = rg_lines(path, lang, re.escape(word), ["-S", "-w"])
    return cache[key]


def best_words(path, lang, words, cache):
    """The words that match at least once, most selective first."""
    counted = [(len(word_lines(path, lang, word, cache)), word) for word in words]
    return [word for count, word in sorted(counted, key=lambda c: (c[0], -len(c[1]), c[1])) if count]


def declaration_lines(path, lang, file, symbol, member):
    """(line number, text) of every declaration of `symbol` in `file`, as rg finds them."""
    pattern = RC.declaration_pattern(symbol, lang, member)
    out = RC.run(["rg", "-n", "--no-heading", "--color", "never", "-e", pattern, file], cwd=path, check=False).stdout
    found = []
    for line in out.splitlines():
        number, _, text = line.partition(":")
        found.append((int(number), text))
    return found


def strip_literals(text, lang):
    """Drops strings and line comments so their brackets do not count."""
    if lang is RC.LANGS["rust"]:
        text = re.sub(r'"(?:\\.|[^"\\])*"', '""', text)
        text = re.sub(r"'(?:\\.|[^'\\])'", "''", text)
        return re.sub(r"//.*", "", text)
    text = re.sub(r'"(?:\\.|[^"\\])*"|\'(?:\\.|[^\'\\])*\'|`(?:\\.|[^`\\])*`', '""', text)
    return re.sub(r"//.*", "", text)


def block_bytes(lines, start, lang):
    """Bytes of the block that starts on `lines[start]`: lines are added while a bracket is open, then while the next
    non-blank line continues the statement or is indented deeper than the declaration."""
    indent = len(lines[start]) - len(lines[start].lstrip())
    depth = 0
    end = start
    for end in range(start, len(lines)):
        stripped = strip_literals(lines[end], lang)
        depth += sum(stripped.count(c) for c in "([{") - sum(stripped.count(c) for c in ")]}")
        if depth > 0:
            continue
        upcoming = next((l for l in lines[end + 1:] if l.strip()), None)
        if upcoming is None:
            break
        deeper = len(upcoming) - len(upcoming.lstrip()) > indent
        if not deeper and not upcoming.lstrip().startswith(CONTINUATION):
            break
        if not deeper and not stripped.rstrip().endswith(("=", "(", ",")) and not upcoming.lstrip().startswith(
                ("where", "extends", "implements", "{", "|", "&", ".", "?", ":")):
            break
    return sum(len(line.encode()) + 1 for line in lines[start:end + 1])


def smallest_block(path, lang, file, declarations):
    """Bytes of the smallest block of `file` that holds one of the declarations."""
    lines = (path / file).read_text(errors="replace").splitlines()
    return min(block_bytes(lines, number - 1, lang) for number, _ in declarations)


def declaration_prefix(text):
    """The first 40 characters of a declaration line without its export keywords, as rg-compare compares them."""
    bare = re.sub(r"^(?:export\s+|default\s+|declare\s+)+", "", text).rstrip(" {;").strip()
    return bare[:40].translate(BARE)


def monokl_cost(binary, query, path, expected, declarations):
    """Runs monokl once; returns (bytes, answerable in the first rows, how many rows were printed)."""
    out = RC.run([binary, "search", query, "."], cwd=path, check=False).stdout
    rows = [(m.group(1).removeprefix("./"), int(m.group(2)), int(m.group(3)), line)
            for line in out.splitlines() if (m := ROW.match(line))]
    answerable = False
    for file, start, end, text in rows[:TOP_ROWS]:
        shown = text.translate(BARE)
        if file in expected and any(
                start <= number <= end and declaration_prefix(decl) in shown for number, decl in expected[file]):
            answerable = True
    return len(out.encode()), answerable, len(rows)


def rg_policy(path, lang, words, identifier, expected, cache):
    """Simulates the rg-only agent; returns its turns, bytes, whether the expected file was read, and the early-stop
    turns and bytes."""
    usable = best_words(path, lang, words, cache)
    turns = []
    if usable:
        first = word_lines(path, lang, usable[0], cache)
        turns.append(first)
        if len(first) > NARROW_ABOVE:
            if identifier:
                narrower = rg_lines(path, lang, RC.declaration_pattern(identifier, lang))
            elif len(usable) > 1:
                a, b = (re.escape(w) for w in usable[:2])
                narrower = rg_lines(path, lang, rf"\b{a}\b.*\b{b}\b|\b{b}\b.*\b{a}\b", ["-i"])
            else:
                narrower = None
            if narrower is not None:
                turns.append(narrower)
    spent = 0
    early = None
    located = False
    for number, lines in enumerate(turns, 1):
        shown, cost = read_cost(lines)
        spent += cost
        for line in shown:
            file, _, rest = line.partition(":")
            if file in expected:
                located = True
                if early is None and int(rest.partition(":")[0]) in {n for n, _ in expected[file]}:
                    early = (number, spent)
    read = min(smallest_block(path, lang, file, decls) for file, decls in expected.items())
    full = (len(turns) + 1, spent + read)
    return full, located, early or full


def identifier_rows(binary, repo_filter, count):
    for name, url, sha, lang, held_out in RC.repositories(repo_filter):
        if held_out:
            continue
        path = RC.checkout(name, url, sha)
        for term in RC.sample_terms(path, count, lang):
            files, _ = RC.split(RC.definitions(term, path, lang), lang)
            if files:
                yield {"repo": name, "lang": lang, "path": path, "kind": "identifier", "query": term,
                       "words": [term], "identifier": term, "symbol": term, "member": False,
                       "files": sorted(files)}


def question_rows(repo_filter):
    checkouts = {name: (RC.checkout(name, url, sha), lang) for name, url, sha, lang, _ in RC.repositories(repo_filter)}
    for repo, words, file, symbol, member, held_out in RC.question_rows(repo_filter):
        path, lang = checkouts[repo]
        yield {"repo": repo, "lang": lang, "path": path, "kind": "member" if member else "question", "query": words,
               "words": words.split(), "identifier": None, "symbol": symbol, "member": member, "files": [file],
               "held_out": held_out}


def set_names(row, report_only):
    rust = row["lang"] is RC.LANGS["rust"]
    held = row.get("held_out", False)
    if held and row["repo"] in report_only:
        name = "report-only"
    elif held:
        name = "held-out rust" if rust else "held-out members" if row["member"] else "held-out questions"
    elif rust:
        name = "rust"
    else:
        name = {"identifier": "identifiers", "question": "questions", "member": "members"}[row["kind"]]
    return [name, "all"]


def score(binary, row, cache):
    path, lang = row["path"], row["lang"]
    expected = {}
    for file in row["files"]:
        found = declaration_lines(path, lang, file, row["symbol"], row["member"])
        if found:
            expected[file] = found
    if not expected:
        sys.exit(f"{row['repo']}: `{row['symbol']}` has no declaration in {row['files']}; run `just rg-compare`")
    monokl_bytes, answerable, printed = monokl_cost(binary, row["query"], path, expected, None)
    (rg_turns, rg_bytes), located, (early_turns, early_bytes) = rg_policy(
        path, lang, row["words"], row["identifier"], expected, cache)
    block = min(smallest_block(path, lang, file, decls) for file, decls in expected.items())
    return {
        "repo": row["repo"], "kind": row["kind"], "query": row["query"], "symbol": row["symbol"],
        "expected": sorted(expected),
        "answerable": answerable, "rg_located": located, "monokl_rows": printed,
        "monokl": (1, monokl_bytes),
        "monokl+read": (1 if answerable else 2, monokl_bytes + (0 if answerable else block)),
        "rg-policy": (rg_turns, rg_bytes),
        "rg-early": (early_turns, early_bytes),
    }


def table(results, detail):
    print(f"{'set':<19} {'n':>3} {'tool':<11} {'turns med/total':>15} {'bytes median':>13} {'p90':>8} {'total':>10} "
          f"{'tokens median':>14} {'p90':>7} {'total':>9}  one-turn")
    failures = []
    for name in SETS:
        rows = [r for r in results if name in r["sets"]]
        if not rows:
            continue
        stats = {}
        for tool in TOOLS:
            turns = [r[tool][0] for r in rows]
            sizes = [r[tool][1] for r in rows]
            stats[tool] = median(sizes)
            one_turn = sum(r["answerable"] for r in rows) if tool == "monokl" else None
            print(f"{name if tool == 'monokl' else '':<19} {len(rows) if tool == 'monokl' else '':>3} {tool:<11} "
                  f"{f'{median(turns):g}/{sum(turns)}':>15} {median(sizes):>13,.0f} {percentile(sizes, 0.9):>8,} "
                  f"{sum(sizes):>10,} {tokens(median(sizes)):>14,} {tokens(percentile(sizes, 0.9)):>7,} "
                  f"{tokens(sum(sizes)):>9,}  "
                  f"{f'{one_turn}/{len(rows)} = {one_turn / len(rows):.0%}' if one_turn is not None else ''}")
        rate = sum(r["answerable"] for r in rows) / len(rows)
        if stats["monokl"] > stats["rg-policy"]:
            failures.append(f"{name}: monokl median {stats['monokl']:,.0f} bytes exceeds rg-policy median "
                            f"{stats['rg-policy']:,.0f}")
        if rate < MIN_ONE_TURN:
            failures.append(f"{name}: answerable in one turn {rate:.0%} is below {MIN_ONE_TURN:.0%}")
    if detail:
        print()
        print("per question: repo | kind | query -> symbol | monokl bytes answerable | rg-policy turns bytes located | "
              "rg-early turns bytes")
        for r in results:
            print(f"{r['repo']} | {r['kind']} | {r['query']!r} -> {r['symbol']} | {r['monokl'][1]} "
                  f"{'yes' if r['answerable'] else 'no'} | {r['rg-policy'][0]} {r['rg-policy'][1]} "
                  f"{'yes' if r['rg_located'] else 'no'} | {r['rg-early'][0]} {r['rg-early'][1]}")
    print()
    for failure in failures:
        print(f"FAIL (report-only, exit status unchanged) {failure}")
    return failures


def summary(results, failures):
    rows = results
    monokl = median([r["monokl"][1] for r in rows])
    rg = median([r["rg-policy"][1] for r in rows])
    one_turn = sum(r["answerable"] for r in rows)
    located = sum(r["rg_located"] for r in rows)
    print(f"summary: {len(rows)} questions; median bytes monokl {monokl:,.0f} ({tokens(monokl):,} tokens, 1 turn) vs "
          f"rg-policy {rg:,.0f} ({tokens(rg):,} tokens, {median([r['rg-policy'][0] for r in rows]):g} turns); "
          f"monokl answerable in one turn {one_turn}/{len(rows)} = {one_turn / len(rows):.0%}; "
          f"rg-policy located the file {located}/{len(rows)}; "
          f"{'FAIL x' + str(len(failures)) if failures else 'no failing marker'} (report-only)")


def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__, formatter_class=argparse.RawDescriptionHelpFormatter)
    parser.add_argument("--binary", default=str(ROOT / "target" / "release" / "monokl"))
    parser.add_argument("--repo", action="append", help="limit to a repository name from rg-compare.repos")
    parser.add_argument("--terms", type=int, default=25, help="identifiers sampled per repository, as rg-compare.py")
    parser.add_argument("--detail", action="store_true", help="print one line per question after the table")
    parser.add_argument("--json", help="write every row to this path")
    args = parser.parse_args()

    if not Path(args.binary).exists():
        sys.exit(f"{args.binary} not found; run `cargo build --release` or pass --binary")
    RC.configure(args.binary)
    report_only = RC.report_only_repositories()

    cache = {}
    results = []
    for row in [*identifier_rows(args.binary, args.repo, args.terms), *question_rows(args.repo)]:
        result = score(args.binary, row, cache)
        result["sets"] = set_names(row, report_only)
        results.append(result)
    if not results:
        sys.exit("no rows to score")

    print("agent workflow cost: one monokl search vs a fixed rg policy; bytes, tokens = ceil(bytes / 3), no timing")
    failures = table(results, args.detail)
    summary(results, failures)
    if args.json:
        Path(args.json).write_text(json.dumps(results, indent=2, default=str))


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

        for term in RC.sample_terms(path, count, lang):
            files, _ = RC.split(RC.definitions(term, path, lang), lang)
            if files:

                       "words": [term], "identifier": term, "symbol": term, "member": False,
                       "files": sorted(files)}


def question_rows(repo_filter):
    checkouts = {name: (RC.checkout(name, url, sha), lang) for name, url, sha, lang, _ in RC.repositories(repo_filter)}
    for repo, words, file, symbol, member, held_out in RC.question_rows(repo_filter):
        path, lang = checkouts[repo]
        yield {"repo": repo, "lang": lang, "path": path, "kind": "member" if member else "question", "query": words,
               "words": words.split(), "identifier": None, "symbol": symbol, "member": member, "files": [file],
               "held_out": held_out}

    rust = row["lang"] is RC.LANGS["rust"]
    held = row.get("held_out", False)
    if held and row["repo"] in report_only:
        name = "report-only"
    elif held:
        name = "held-out rust" if rust else "held-out members" if row["member"] else "held-out questions"

            sizes = [r[tool][1] for r in rows]
            stats[tool] = median(sizes)
            one_turn = sum(r["answerable"] for r in rows) if tool == "monokl" else None
            print(f"{name if tool == 'monokl' else '':<19} {len(rows) if tool == 'monokl' else '':>3} {tool:<11} "
                  f"{f'{median(turns):g}/{sum(turns)}':>15} {median(sizes):>13,.0f} {percentile(sizes, 0.9):>8,} "
                  f"{sum(sizes):>10,} {tokens(median(sizes)):>14,} {tokens(percentile(sizes, 0.9)):>7,} "
                  f"{tokens(sum(sizes)):>9,}  "

    parser.add_argument("--binary", default=str(ROOT / "target" / "release" / "monokl"))
    parser.add_argument("--repo", action="append", help="limit to a repository name from rg-compare.repos")
    parser.add_argument("--terms", type=int, default=25, help="identifiers sampled per repository, as rg-compare.py")
    parser.add_argument("--detail", action="store_true", help="print one line per question after the table")

    print("agent workflow cost: one monokl search vs a fixed rg policy; bytes, tokens = ceil(bytes / 3), no timing")
    failures = table(results, args.detail)
    summary(results, failures)

        Path(args.json).write_text(json.dumps(results, indent=2, default=str))
